+"""Prepare a release: bump the version in fastapi/__init__.py and date the release notes.
+
+Usage: python scripts/prepare_release.py [major|minor|patch]
+"""
+
+import re
+import sys
+from datetime import date
+from pathlib import Path
+
+INIT_FILE = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+VERSION_PATTERN = re.compile(r'^__version__ = "(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)"\s*$', re.MULTILINE)
+RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^## (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\s*(\(.*\))?\s*$")
+
+
+def bump_version(version: str, kind: str = "patch") -> str:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)", version)
+    if not match:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid version: {version}")
+    major, minor, patch = (int(part) for part in match.groups())
+    if kind == "major":
+        return f"{major + 1}.0.0"
+    if kind == "minor":
+        return f"{major}.{minor + 1}.0"
+    if kind == "patch":
+        return f"{major}.{minor}.{patch + 1}"
+    raise ValueError(f"Invalid bump kind: {kind}")
+
+
+def get_current_version(content: str) -> str:
+    match = VERSION_PATTERN.search(content)
+    if not match:
+        raise ValueError("No __version__ found")
+    return ".".join(match.groups())
+
+
+def update_version_content(content: str, new_version: str) -> str:
+    return VERSION_PATTERN.sub(f'__version__ = "{new_version}"', content, count=1)
+
+
+def add_release_date(lines: list[str], version: str, today: str) -> list[str]:
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        match = RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN.match(line.rstrip("\n"))
+        if not match:
+            continue
+        if match.group(2):
+            return lines
+        lines[i] = f"## {version} ({today})\n"
+        return lines
+    raise ValueError("No release header found")
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
+    args = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
+    kind = args[0] if args else "patch"
+
+    content = INIT_FILE.read_text()
+    current = get_current_version(content)
+    new_version = bump_version(current, kind)
+    INIT_FILE.write_text(update_version_content(content, new_version))
+    print(f"Bumped version: {current} -> {new_version}")
+
+    lines = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
+    lines = add_release_date(lines, new_version, date.today().isoformat())
+    RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.write_text("".join(lines))
+    print(f"Updated release notes for {new_version}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
